tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: UCP 2026-04-08 catalog search over the engagement tiers. Returns UCP product objects in structuredContent. Call with no query for the whole catalog.

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: UCP 2026-04-08 catalog lookup: resolve engagement ids (e.g. readiness-sprint) to UCP product objects.

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: List every Expanding Web engagement tier with id, price, currency and what it includes.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Full record for one engagement tier: price, turnaround, deliverables, pricing policy and limits.

tools.name: scan_store
tools.description: Run the free eight-check agent-readiness scan against a live storefront and return the verdicts. Read-only, at most three pages, 15-second budget, robots.txt honoured. Limited to 5 scans per hour.

tools.name: create_checkout_session
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout Session and return its URL — for the Agentic Commerce Readiness Sprint (readiness-sprint) or for Pro licences of the Agentic Commerce Suite Magento module (module-pro, one licence per Magento installation, volume discount from 3). Payment is completed by the buyer at that UR

tools.name: report_problem
tools.description: Report something on this site or endpoint that stopped you from completing a task: a page you could not read, data you could not find, a request that was refused. Read by a human. Use this instead of giving up silently — it is the only way we learn that an agent failed here.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_checkout_session" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
